text:
olivia: Quick after-action on the token-validation incident (runbook id: 9b). Main recurring causes = missing audit-hook on some services + at least one stale service token. Using this thread to track owners/timelines for remediation.

sam: thanks. TL;DR of owners?

olivia: Assignments: 
  1) service-token sweep & rotation automation — owner @priyanka — due EOD Thu.
  2) audit-hook config enforcement (deny if missing) — owner @navid — due next Tue.
  3) postmortem doc edits + regression tests in CI — owner @esther — due Fri.
  4) longer-term: secrets lifecycle policy + scheduled audits — owner @matt — Q2 deliverable.

priyanka: I can take rotation automation. Plan: prototype a lambda + k8s cronjob that calls introspection + rotates tokens that fail. ETA Wed for initial PR.

navid: I will add a k8s admission/mutating webhook to require the audit-hook annotation; need to scope service list. @priyanka can you share inventory of services with service tokens?

priyanka: Yup, will share tonight. Quick helper command I used to enumerate annotations: 
```
kubectl get svc -A -o jsonpath='{range .items[*]}{.metadata.namespace}/{.metadata.name}{"|"}{.metadata.annotations.audit}{"\n"}{end}'
```

esther: I'll add unit tests to the validation pipeline and a smoke test for QA that validates token introspection end-to-end. Will also update the postmortem doc with repro steps.

matt: For the lifecycle policy I'll draft an RFC and sync with Legal on retention/rotation windows. Tentative target end of quarter but can accelerate if needed.

infra-bot: deploybot: Canary rollout scheduled for audit-hook enforcement to dev cluster at 2024-07-20T22:00Z (staged).

sam: We should define a fast fallback if automation PR slips — i.e., documented manual rotation + who oncall to ping. @olivia can you own the fallback doc?

priyanka: PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/service-token-rotation/pull/42 — requesting review from @navid and @esther.

esther: reviewing now, quick comment: tests need to mock introspection endpoint and assert token swapped.

navid: pushed initial policy snippet to infra repo: ``deny if audit.annotation missing`` — will refine rules and add exception list. Pushing full PR by EOD.

sec-bot: security: Created ticket SEC-981 linking incident-712: "Audit-hook enforcement & token rotation automation". Severity: Medium. ETA target: 2025-04-02.

olivia: Great progress. I updated the action checklist in the postmortem doc: https://docs.redwood/postmortems/incident-712#followups. We will have a short sync Thu 10am PT to confirm blockers and roll schedule. If you can't make it, drop updates here.

matt: FYI I might be OOO Thu morning; I'll post RFC draft before then.

sam: thanks everyone :thumbsup: I've marked owners on the remediation board and added weekly reminders.
